A DIFFERENT KIND OF FLIGHT PLAN. ✈️🌿

Some pilots volunteer to give their communities a perspective they can’t get from the ground.

SouthWings is celebrating 30 years of that work—and a new November 9 report recognizes the volunteers behind it.

At its October anniversary fly-in on Lookout Mountain, the organization honored pilots supporting conservation work across the Southeast and Gulf region. Its network now includes 84 volunteer pilots, according to SouthWings officials.

Among the honorees: Dallas pilot Eric Jakimier, recognized for flying from Texas to complete 13 volunteer missions across Louisiana since 2023. Christopher and Justine Noth of Tampa received the Dynamic Duo award for their combination of flying and aerial photography.

Co-founders Hume Davenport and Jay Mills received the first Legacy Awards, honoring more than two decades of support.

It’s a reminder that general aviation’s value isn’t measured only in miles traveled. Sometimes it’s the view a pilot shares—and what a community can learn from it. 💛

Sources: General Aviation News, November 9, 2026; SouthWings anniversary event information. Reporting on the October 9–11 gathering.
